01486 gowral {go:-ra:l'}

字根已不使用, 意為"粗糙" (如石頭); TWOT - 381a; 陽性名詞

欽定本 - lot 77; 77

1) 鬮: 用來抽籤用的小鵝卵石
   1a) 用來分地
   1b) 用來分配職責或制定懲罰
   1c) 被分配, 指派的東西
   1d) 所得的分: 報酬, 報應
record.edic_text:
01486 gowral {go-rawl'} or (shortened) goral {go-ral'}

from an unused root meaning to be rough (as stone); TWOT - 381a; n m

AV - lot 77; 77

1) lot
   1a) lot - pebbles used for systematically making decisions
2) portion
   2a) lot, portion (thing assigned by casting lots)
   2b) recompense, retribution
